row: ProActive Health Group (PHG) is a multidisciplinary centre located in the heart of downtown Calgary. Focused on optimizing function, our team employs an integrated clinical approach providing lasting improvements in the health of the patients we serve. PHG delivers unparalleled health care excellence keeping our clients active and enjoying the activities they love to do.
